integrity: The general theorem is proved from exact three-candidate majority-margin geometry and parity. A standard-library replay independently computes Kemeny winners by pairwise-margin and direct Kendall-distance methods and exhausts all anonymous odd-electorate profiles through seventeen voters as a finite stress test.
scientific_limitations: Three candidates, complete strict ballots, odd electorate, and unilateral ballot changes only; arbitrary tie-breaking, even-electorate extensions, coalitions, and four or more candidates are not covered.
title: Tie-localization of unilateral manipulation for three-candidate Kemeny voting
